plan.name: Cool Mug Using Refrigerator
plan.strategy: Use the fridge to cool the mug directly, then place it in the coffeemachine.
steps: Find a mug in one of the cabinets, drawers, or on countertops.
Take the mug and place it in the fridge to cool it.
Wait for the mug to cool sufficiently.
Retrieve the cooled mug from the fridge.
Place the cooled mug into the coffeemachine.
